blueprint:automation/local/tap-up-bright.source:
# Compiled from Python by Hassle. Do not edit -- edit the source and recompile.
# Source: switches.py
blueprint:
  name: 'Tap up: brighter'
  description: One tap of the upper paddle steps this room's light up.
  domain: automation
  input:
    room_light:
      description: The light this switch owns.
      selector:
        entity:
          filter:
            - domain: light
    step_up_pct:
      description: How far one tap of the upper paddle brightens.
      selector:
        number:
          min: 1
          max: 100
      default: 10
    button_up:
      description: The switch's upper paddle.
      selector:
        entity:
          filter:
            - domain: event
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: !input button_up
    not_from:
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: !input room_light
    data:
      brightness_step_pct: !input step_up_pct
mode: restart

step_up_pct.description: How far one tap of the upper paddle brightens.

blueprint:automation/local/tap-down-dimm.source:
# Compiled from Python by Hassle. Do not edit -- edit the source and recompile.
# Source: switches.py
blueprint:
  name: 'Tap down: dimmer'
  description: One tap of the lower paddle steps this room's light down.
  domain: automation
  input:
    room_light:
      description: The light this switch owns.
      selector:
        entity:
          filter:
            - domain: light
    step_down_pct:
      description: How far one tap of the lower paddle dims.
      selector:
        number:
          min: -100
          max: -1
      default: -10
    button_down:
      description: The switch's lower paddle.
      selector:
        entity:
          filter:
            - domain: event
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: !input button_down
    not_from:
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
  - trigger: template
    value_template: '{{ states(''sensor.room_lux'') | float(-1) < 0 }}'
    for:
      hours: 0
      minutes: 2
      seconds: 0
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: !input room_light
    data:
      brightness_step_pct: !input step_down_pct
mode: restart

step_down_pct.description: How far one tap of the lower paddle dims.
